observations: Public-request and sealed-scorer separation is necessary but not sufficient; executor admission must be precommitted and permanently deny already exposed identities.
Append-only receipt ingestion must validate exact schema and one complete cross-bound cohort, not only individual receipt digests.
A synthetic success path is useful for infrastructure falsification but must remain explicitly disjoint from genuine held-out observation evidence.
A post-publication review fix requires a new non-force exact head and new CI; a successful superseded workflow is not valid merge evidence.
reason: The bounded deterministic rendezvous passed without evidence justifying a prompt Candidate or any routing activation; subsequent O components should evaluate and select the next independent unit.
